# James Guevara Gamboa

> Frontend & Full Stack Developer based in Heredia, Costa Rica, open to remote work (also hybrid or on-site). Builds fast, SEO-friendly websites and web apps for real estate, corporate and e-commerce clients with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Strapi, Shopify and WordPress.

James Guevara Gamboa is a freelance Full Stack Developer (since August 2024) with 10+ client projects delivered in real estate, corporate and e-commerce, with a focus on performance, SEO and maintainability. Previous roles: Frontend & WordPress Developer at TechPro Solutions (January to July 2024) and Frontend Developer at ContraLuz (March to December 2023, remote). Languages: Spanish (native), English (B2).

## Quick facts (recruiter FAQ)
- Role: Frontend & Full Stack Developer.
- Main stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js; Strapi (headless CMS), Tailwind CSS, REST and GraphQL, Shopify and WordPress customization.
- Availability: open to remote work; also open to hybrid or on-site roles.
- Location and time zone: Heredia, Costa Rica, UTC-6 (no daylight saving time).
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (B2).
- Contact: jjguevarag@gmail.com, LinkedIn and GitHub (below), or the CV PDFs above.

## Core stack
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP
- Backend and APIs: Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, GraphQL
- CMS and e-commerce: Strapi (headless), Shopify, WordPress, Drupal
- Databases: MongoDB, MySQL

## Experience
- Freelance Full Stack Developer, August 2024 to present: websites and web apps for 10+ clients with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js and Strapi; Tailwind, REST/GraphQL, Shopify customization, SEO and Core Web Vitals.
- Frontend & WordPress Developer, TechPro Solutions, January to July 2024: WordPress sites, custom themes and plugins, UI/UX, SEO, agile team.
- Frontend Developer, ContraLuz (remote), March to December 2023: Next.js landing page with 100% Lighthouse performance, led the Shopify migration and launch, custom cart with analytics tracking, SSR admin panel.
